title: liq-1 realizability: 2e6 liquidity floor (20-bar median money, previous_date) on the 偷鸡 candidate list at the book own feasibility minimum
hypothesis: The 偷鸡 leg buys the smallest <¥10 names after ROE/ROA; if those trade below the fill-feasibility minimum, the measured 规模因子 return is funded by names this book could not fill (the 小市值 7/8 不可成交 / ETF溢价 8.44→1.10 pattern) and R=1.
why: type: realizability. BLOCKS the exit gate (realizability unset ⇒ blocked) and is the only test that can REJECT the family outright. Floor derivation: harness capital 1,000,000 (epoch-9 config) / g.stock_num 10 = 100,000 per full position; order_volume_ratio 0.05 ⇒ 100,000/0.05 = 2e6 CNY/day = the feasibility MINIMUM, not a comfort level. DECISION RULE (declared before the number): R=1 if the floor removes most held names — heldRemoved >= 6 of 10 on >= 2 of the 3 entry days — OR the summed 偷鸡 return collapses below +32% (half the base +63.90, u-3 accounting) OR the book drops below the 1.0 sharpe gate; R>=2 if near-inert — heldRemoved <= 1 on every entry day AND |Δobjective| < 0.05 vs 0.7266 (bit-identical, as 大小盘轮动 e9-r1/e9-r2, is the clean case); between = partial bite, R=2 only if the gate still passes, and liq-2 then decides nothing about 3. Either outcome is information; a likely-R=1 result is a strong reason to RUN it, not to skip it (§4 u-3 note: 偷鸡 holds 002247-type micro-caps, so the floor is probably NOT inert here, unlike 大小盘轮动 whose dividend chain incidentally excluded illiquid names). ⚠ Caveats to carry into the score: (a) the 14:00 补跌 add-on puts cash/3 into a held loser, so positions can exceed 100k; (b) the book compounds (+~60% by the 11-21 entry), so the true per-position need at entry 3 is ~1.5×2e6 — liq-2 covers both; (c) zero-slippage bench. Cost ~3-6 backtest-min (one extra 20-bar money fetch on 3 days).
